sourceQuotes.zh: 文明皇后崩及武元楊后崩，天下將吏發哀三日止。
sourceQuotes.en: When Empress Dowager Yuan died and when Empress Yang the consort of Wu died, officers empire-wide wailed three days only.

sourceQuotes.zh: 寧康二年七月，簡文帝崩再周而遇閏。
sourceQuotes.en: In the second year of Ningkang, in the seventh month, Emperor Jianwen died just as the second mourning round collided with an intercalary month.

sourceQuotes.zh: 喪事先遠，則應用博士吳商之言，以閏月祥。」
sourceQuotes.en: For mourning affairs, one first chooses what is distant; therefore one should use the words of Erudite Wu Shang and hold the xiang sacrifice in the intercalary month."

sourceQuotes.zh: 尚書令王彪之、侍中王混、中丞譙王恬、右丞戴謐等議異，彪之曰：「吳商中才小官，非名賢碩儒、公輔重臣、為時所準則者。
sourceQuotes.en: Director of the Secretariat Wang Biaozhi, Palace Attendant Wang Hun, Censor-in-Chief Prince Tian of Qiao, Right Assistant Director Dai Mi, and others deliberated differently. Biaozhi said, "Wu Shang was a man of middling talent and a minor official, not a famous worthy, great classicist, high minister, or weighty servant whom the age should take as a standard.

sourceQuotes.zh: 魏武以正月崩，魏文以其年七月設妓樂百戲，是則魏不以喪廢樂也。
sourceQuotes.en: Cao Cao died in the first month; Cao Pi still staged troupes and acrobats that seventh month—so Wei never treated mourning as a reason to silence the bands.

sourceQuotes.zh: 武帝以來，國有大喪，輒廢樂終三年。
sourceQuotes.en: Under Emperor Sima Yan, every dynastic bereavement silenced the orchestras for three years.

sourceQuotes.zh: 武帝楊悼皇后既母養懷帝，后遇難時，懷帝尚幼，及即位，中詔述后恩愛。
sourceQuotes.en: Empress Yang had raised the future Emperor Huai; when she was killed he was still a child, and on enthronement he issued a palace rescript praising her care.

sourceQuotes.zh: 今以恩禮追崇，不配世祖廟。
sourceQuotes.en: Now by kindness and ritual we posthumously honor her—not pairing her in Emperor Shizu's temple.

sourceQuotes.zh: 孝武帝太元十五年，淑媛陳氏卒，皇太子所生也。
sourceQuotes.en: In the fifteenth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu, Honored Lady Chen died; she was the birth mother of the crown prince.

sourceQuotes.zh: 太元二十一年，孝武帝崩，孝武太后制三年之服。
sourceQuotes.en: In the twenty-first year of Taiyuan, Emperor Xiaowu died, and Empress Dowager Xiaowu established three-year mourning dress.

sourceQuotes.zh: 摯虞以為：「古者諸侯君臨其國，臣諸父兄，今之諸侯未同于古。
sourceQuotes.en: Zhi Yu held: "Ancient feudal lords ruled their states and treated paternal uncles as subjects; today's nobles are not the same as antiquity.

sourceQuotes.zh: 昔魏武帝建安中已曾表上，漢朝依古為制，事與古異，皆不施行，施行者著在魏科。
sourceQuotes.en: Wei Emperor Wu in the Jian'an era already memorialized for Han to legislate by antiquity; because affairs differed from antiquity, nothing was enacted, while what was enacted appears in Wei code.

sourceQuotes.zh: 大晉采以著令，宜定新禮皆如舊。」
sourceQuotes.en: Great Jin adopted those entries into promulgated law—the New Rites ought everywhere to match the old statute."

sourceQuotes.zh: 宣帝豫自于首陽山為土藏，不填不樹，作《顧命終制》，斂以時服，不設明器。
sourceQuotes.en: Sima Yi dug a plain shaft on Shouyang, left the hill unmarked, and left written orders for everyday clothes and no grave goods.

sourceQuotes.zh: 武帝泰始四年，文明王皇后崩，將合葬，開崇陽陵，使太尉司馬望奉祭，進皇帝密璽綬于便房神坐。
sourceQuotes.en: In the fourth year of Taishi under Emperor Wu, when Empress Wenming Wang died and was about to be jointly buried, Chongyang Mausoleum was opened, Grand Commandant Sima Wang was sent to present sacrifice, and the emperor's sealed jade seal and cords were advanced to the spirit seat in the side chamber.

sourceQuotes.zh: 及宣帝，遺詔「子弟群官皆不得謁陵」。
sourceQuotes.en: Emperor Xuan's testament commanded that "sons, younger kin, and all officials must not visit the imperial tombs."
Sima Shi and Sima Zhao complied.

sourceQuotes.zh: 至武帝，猶再謁崇陽陵，一謁峻平陵，然遂不敢謁高原陵，至惠帝復止也。
sourceQuotes.en: Sima Yan alone made limited visits, never to Cao Cao's mound, and Hui abandoned the habit entirely.
